summary: Iteration 11: mandatory 2FA (TOTP) at login for every role. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass in /tmp/test_iter11.py, run against the public URL. Covered: security headers, no secrets in the JS bundle, password-only login gives 2fa_required, TOTP replay rejected, recovery codes are single use and work in any case with or without the dash, 2fa/disable returns 400, developer GET /companies returns [], a token without typ is rejected, setup_token gets 401 on /auth/me, /companies GET and POST, setup_token rejected after enrollment, regenerating recovery codes invalidates the old ones, collaborator enrollment plus reset-2fa (old session gets 401 and the next login returns setup_required again), owner cannot reset their own 2FA, a non-owner cannot reset, 5 wrong codes give 429 'Troppi tentativi' on a throwaway titolare. Frontend (Playwright): all requested flows pass. Developer enrollment: QR and secret shown, wrong code gives an error, 10 recovery codes, 'Entra nel programma' disabled until the checkbox is ticked, then lands on /sviluppatore. Code step: replay rejected in the UI, next-window code accepted, toggle-recovery works (lowercase without dash), reused recovery code rejected. Settings card shows 'Attiva e obbligatoria per tutti', recovery-codes-left and no Disattiva button. Regenerating in the UI gives 10 new codes; an old code then fails and a new one works. Owner invite in the UI: redirect to /login with invite-accepted-notice, email prefilled, no token stored, forced enrollment, full owner menu (39 items). Collaborator invite: forced enrollment. Owner clicks reset-2fa-{id}, gets the 'Verifica azzerata' toast, and the collaborator must enroll again. Idle logout and developer isolation still work. Working tree grep for the developer password and Demo2026demo (excluding node_modules/.git/test_reports/backend/.env): 0 hits. BUT git history still contains both strings.

critical.issue: The developer password ('[password sviluppatore]') appears in 19 places in `git log --all -p` and 'Demo2026demo' in 33, in older commits of memory/test_credentials.md and test_reports/iteration_3..9.json. If the repo is pushed or made public, the password is exposed even though the working tree is clean. The developer password must be rotated, and the history rewritten (git filter-repo / BFG) or a fresh repo published.

minor.issue: JWT_SECRET falls back to the hard-coded 'dev-secret-change-me' when the env var is missing. In public code this lets anyone forge tokens if the env var is ever unset. Fail fast instead of defaulting. SEED_DEMO also defaults to True and CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*'.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*' (bearer tokens, allow_credentials=False, so not directly exploitable). Explicit origins are recommended.
When demo seeding runs, the generated DEMO_PASSWORD is written to the server log in clear text ('Caricati i dati di esempio ... password: %s').
Any titolare can reset 2FA for, or deactivate, another titolare of the same group (seen in the Members UI: Azzera verifica/Disattiva shown on other titolari). Confirm this is intended.
An existing user accepts with the password only (no 2nd factor) to gain the new memberships. Low risk because it still needs a valid invite token.

issues: The DEMO array (titolare@demo.it, etc.) and the text 'la password è nel log del server' are still in the code and bundle. They are hidden by REACT_APP_SHOW_DEMO_LOGIN, but the default is shown (!== 'false'). Remove them for production.
Many interactive elements have no data-testid (invite modal inputs, Disattiva/Riattiva, role selects, Revoca, Copia link).

critical_code_review_comments: The 2FA implementation is solid: atomic replay protection via a totp_last_step conditional update, recovery codes stored as SHA-256 hashes and removed atomically with $pull, wrong codes counted toward lockout, typ-checked JWTs, and a token_version bump on reset
totp_step accepts the +1 window, so two logins inside one 30 s window are possible (current, then next). This is acceptable

Companies: TEST_Azienda 2FA, TEST_UI Azienda, TEST_Reset Azienda. The developer is now enrolled in 2FA (the main agent plans to wipe the DB).

context_for_next_testing_agent: TOTP codes are computed from the totp-secret text (pyotp or a stdlib HMAC). Each step is single-use per user; the step+1 code is accepted. The token is in localStorage key 'tesoreria_token'. Logout button: role=button name 'Esci'. The owner Members page shows reset-2fa-{id} for every non-self member, including other titolari, so target a specific id.
